seo.title: Case Study: Interior Design Studio — Landing Page | Máximo Silva
seo.description: How I built the landing page for an interior design studio, staying true to its visual identity and presenting its portfolio professionally.

hero.title: Interior Design Studio — a portfolio
hero.subtitle: An interior design studio that needed a website capable of faithfully reflecting its visual identity and presenting its portfolio professionally.

desafio.title: The Challenge
desafio.texto: The studio already had a well-developed brand design, but had no website that faithfully reflected it. The challenge was translating that existing design into a web experience fully adapted to mobile devices, without losing any visual detail along the way.

solucion.title: The Solution
solucion.texto: I built a custom landing page with a project gallery, original illustrations, and contact options, staying true to every visual detail on both desktop and mobile to ensure a consistent brand experience.
incluye: Custom landing page based on existing design
Original illustrations integrated into the design
Faithful responsive experience on desktop and mobile

resultado.title: The Result
resultado.texto: The studio now has a custom landing page that faithfully reflects its visual identity and presents its portfolio professionally, with a consistent experience across any device.
